prompt: Who is the best therapist in Austin, Texas?
text:
There isn’t one objectively “best” therapist in Austin—the best fit depends on your goals, insurance, budget, and preferred approach. Based on current specialization and credentials, I’d start with these:

- **For anxiety, OCD, panic, or evidence-based CBT:** **Dr. Tamara Bryan / Austin Center for CBT**. She is a licensed clinical psychologist with more than 20 years of CBT experience and offers CBT, ERP for OCD, and Gottman-based couples work. ([atxcbt.com](https://www.atxcbt.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **For couples, trauma, grief, or postpartum concerns:** **Marsha Lowes Psychotherapy**. She focuses on couples therapy, attachment, trauma, grief, perinatal transitions, and IFS-informed work. ([marshalowespsychotherapy.com](https://www.marshalowespsychotherapy.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **For trauma, PTSD, EMDR, first responders, veterans, or LGBTQ+ clients:** **Austin Counseling & Trauma Specialists**. The practice includes licensed psychologists, counselors, and social workers and specializes in trauma-informed care. ([austincts.com](https://www.austincts.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **For a larger practice with matching, insurance options, and evening/weekend availability:** **Just Mind Counseling**. It has 50+ clinicians, offers in-person and telehealth care, and treats anxiety, trauma, ADHD/neurodivergence, depression, and relationship concerns. ([justmind.org](https://justmind.org/marriage-and-couples-counseling/?utm_source=openai))
- **For general adult therapy, anxiety, relationships, or LGBTQIA+-affirming care:** **Grace Therapy & Wellness** offers several clinicians with training in EMDR, DBT, psychodynamic therapy, and OCD treatment. ([gracetherapyaustin.com](https://www.gracetherapyaustin.com/?utm_source=openai))

**My practical recommendation:**  
If you’re unsure where to begin, contact **Just Mind** for matching, or schedule brief consultations with two individual therapists. Ask:

1. “Do you regularly treat my specific issue?”
2. “What treatment approach would you use?”
3. “Do you take my insurance, and what is the out-of-pocket cost?”
4. “How soon can I start?”
5. “What happens if we’re not a good fit?”

The therapist’s license can be verified through the **Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council**. If you’re in immediate danger or considering suicide, call or text **988** or go to the nearest emergency room.
matchedPractices: Grace Therapy and Wellness, PLLC - Downtown Location One

prompt: Recommend an anxiety therapist in Austin, Texas
text:
A strong starting recommendation is **Austin Center for CBT**, especially if you want structured, evidence-based treatment for generalized anxiety, panic, social anxiety, stress, or OCD. It’s led by **Dr. Tamara Bryan**, a licensed clinical psychologist, and offers CBT—including exposure-based approaches—via teletherapy throughout Texas. ([atxcbt.com](https://www.atxcbt.com/?utm_source=openai))

Other good Austin-area options:

- **Anxiety Treatment Center of Austin** — specializes in anxiety and OCD, with clinicians focused specifically on anxiety disorders; they currently advertise introductory consultations. ([anxietyaustin.com](https://www.anxietyaustin.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Central Texas Anxiety and OCD Center** — treats adults, adolescents, and children using CBT and ERP for conditions including panic disorder, social anxiety, GAD, phobias, and OCD. ([centraltexasanxiety.clientsecure.me](https://centraltexasanxiety.clientsecure.me/?utm_source=openai))
- **Just Mind Counseling** — offers in-person offices in North and South Austin, plus online therapy, with evening and weekend availability. ([justmind.org](https://justmind.org/anxiety-counseling/?utm_source=openai))
- **Deanna Graves, LPC** — offers Austin/in-person and Texas-wide telehealth, with CBT, ACT, mindfulness-based therapy, and a free 30-minute consultation; lists Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Oscar, Lyra, and Moda among accepted plans. ([deannagraves.com](https://www.deannagraves.com/?utm_source=openai))

**My practical pick:**  
- Choose **Austin Center for CBT** for classic skills-based anxiety treatment.  
- Choose **Anxiety Treatment Center of Austin** if anxiety or OCD is your primary concern and you want a specialist practice.  
- Choose **Just Mind** if location, scheduling, or evening/weekend appointments matter most.

Before booking, ask about **Texas licensure, experience with your specific anxiety pattern, insurance/out-of-network benefits, session fee, and earliest availability**. A 15–30 minute consultation is often enough to assess fit.

prompt: Best couples counselor in Austin, Texas
text:
If you want **one strong starting point**, I’d recommend **Westlake Couples Counseling, PLLC**, especially if you’re dealing with recurring conflict, emotional disconnection, or rebuilding trust. Veronica Leal, LPC-S reportedly has **more than 20 years of clinical experience** and uses both the **Gottman Method** and **Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT)**—two well-established approaches for couples work. ([westlakecouplescounseling.com](https://www.westlakecouplescounseling.com/?utm_source=openai))

### Other good Austin options

- **Enhancing Intimacy Counseling — Claudia Thompson, LMFT-S, LPC-S, CST-S**  
  A good fit for couples dealing with intimacy, sexuality, sexual health, or relationship patterns. ([psychologytoday.com](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/tx/austin?category=couples-counseling&page=1&utm_source=openai))

- **Austin STRONG: Relationship Building Center**  
  Worth considering for premarital counseling, communication problems, infidelity recovery, and relationship-building; they advertise trauma-informed and mindfulness-based work, with sliding-fee availability. ([trustanalytica.org](https://trustanalytica.org/us/tx/austin/best-marriage-counselors?utm_source=openai))

- **Danae King, LPC**  
  Potentially a good choice when ADHD, neurodivergence, parenting stress, or trauma affects the relationship; her profile notes Gottman training. ([psychologytoday.com](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/tx/austin?category=couples-counseling&page=1&utm_source=openai))

- **The Center for Relationships**  
  A broader Austin practice offering work with couples and families, with public reviews emphasizing an empathetic and practical style. ([lovefix.app](https://lovefix.app/couples-therapy/austin-tx/?utm_source=openai))

### How I’d choose

Before booking, ask:

1. **Do you primarily treat couples, or mostly individuals?**
2. **Which approach do you use—Gottman, EFT, or another model?**
3. **Do you work with infidelity, high-conflict couples, LGBTQ+ couples, or non-monogamy if relevant?**
4. **What is the session fee, and do you provide superbills for out-of-network insurance?**
5. **Can both partners have a brief consultation before committing?**

For most couples, I’d prioritize **therapist fit and specialized experience over online star ratings**. If there is domestic violence, coercive control, or fear between partners, traditional joint couples counseling may not be appropriate; seek individual support first.
matchedPractices: Liana Mauro, LPC – Somatic & EMDR Therapist
